not_client_data: Fictional demonstration data generated by CreditProbe v5 (R12 Session E). It describes no real bank, company, family, person, developer, consultant or project.

ta_action.label: Thread actions log
ta_action.grain: one row per action on a thread answer
ta_action.writers: t (backend/thread_actions/store.py, on every Word memo and thread action)

ta_memo.label: Thread memos
ta_memo.grain: one row per memo, note or paper written from a thread
ta_memo.writers: t (backend/thread_actions/store.py, on every Word memo and thread action)

module.description: Module of the thread: cockpit, noor, dealdesk, whatif, lenses, ews, b360, scorecard, playbook, intel.

thread_id.description: Thread (or run, panel) the memo was written from.

scope.description: answer (one answer) or thread (every answer in the thread).

kind.description: memo, note or paper (the word the user asked for).

title.description: Title of the document (the thread's subject).

addressee.description: Addressee if one was named (e.g. CRO), else blank.

trigger.description: word_button or memo_intent (typed 'write a memo' in the thread).

request_text.description: What the user typed when the memo came from a request (blank for the button).

sources.description: Sources listed in its trace section.

relations_named.description: Data Domains relations the trace section names.

created_by.description: User who asked for it (fictional demo users).

reporting_quarter.description: Reporting quarter the row belongs to (the Deal Desk book quarter, 2026Q2).

rel_version.description: Version of the relation that published this row (publish() increments it).

published_at.description: UTC time the row's version was published.

answer_id.description: Answer (turn, run) the action was taken on; blank for the whole thread.

action.description: share, trace, word, report or memo_intent.

target.description: What it produced or reached: memo id, mail recipients, Playbook report id.
